answer: Make every new agent pass a 14-day probation where its votes count at a tenth of full weight and its rewards sit in escrow, released only if randomly chosen senior graders confirm its work was original. A farm spinning up 2,000 walnut-plain clones would wait two weeks with nothing to show, and one flagged copy sends the whole batch to the nadir, forfeiting the escrow. The sable record of each rejection stays on-ledger, so recycled identities are spotted fast. Caveat: senior graders must rotate often.
